patterns.note: Full-width sections with varied background treatments (video, solid color, graphic, dark image overlay) are used to clearly delineate content blocks.
A strong typographic hierarchy uses a bold, modern display sans-serif for main titles and a more functional sans-serif for body text and small, uppercase labels.
A high-contrast black and white base is accented by a vibrant red for calls to action and important information, alongside a distinct deep blue for graphic elements.

The primary navigation bar transforms from transparent with white text over the hero video to a solid white background with black text, then sticks to the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down.
Content sections alternate between light and dark backgrounds, often featuring full-bleed imagery or graphics, to create visual rhythm and distinct areas of focus.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero plays in the background, with a subtle overlay to ensure text legibility.
The main navigation bar employs a scroll-triggered state change, transitioning its background and text color as it passes the hero section, then becoming sticky at the top of the viewport.
A persistent information box is fixed to the bottom-right of the screen, remaining visible throughout the scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful display headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, functional uppercase labels and a clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy; the hero section is very airy, while content sections maintain comfortable padding and line spacing.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, graphic-heavy sections, particularly the large, illustrative blue graphic, which breaks from typical content blocks. This, combined with the editorial-style news cards and the high-contrast, limited color palette, creates a sophisticated yet impactful visual experience that feels more like a curated publication than a standard museum site.
